extra.imageProcessing: Real Sweetwater authorized-retailer images are angled, white-background, shadowed and non-transparent; the real-first gate rejected them. P5-03b repair (2026-10-24): the first generated art (PR #40) was asymmetric — the vertical logo overlapped the right perforation/end cap and the staggered columns were clipped into the right cap. Rebuilt from the official dimensions/layout plus the PedalPlayground Duo 24 gray plan reference for proportions only (no planner pixels shipped): mirrored 22px end caps (#444643, sampled from the Sweetwater left side panel), mirrored black handle pulls, 2 mini + 1 Micro module slot per side as opaque dark recesses, and a centred, unclipped staggered perforation field (8 pill rows at 121/47.3px pitch; 49x25 small-hole grid at 15.46/15.75px pitch; 59/59px pill envelope). No logo overlay. Body #3a3c3b sampled from the Sweetwater main reference (median, 239,602 samples). Perforations and slots are opaque dark ink (#141715 pills, #242725 dots, #222423 slots) so dark/light/checker renders do not bleed white or create halos; the only transparency is the 0.5px outer cutout edge. Rendered 800x408 / 350x178 AVIF q90 (27.4 / 11.8 KB); aspect 1.9608 vs 1.96 (0.04% pass); perspective 0.02%; bright residual 0%, bright edge 0%; no shadow; no white/background/fringe; no reference pixels. Source SVG: tools/asset-pipeline/board-art/temple-audio-duo-24.svg. Design reviewer: confirmation pass approve (fixed asset + app QA).
